विलंबः — 1 Hanging over, pendulousness. --2 Tardiness, delay, procrastination.
विलंबनं — 1 Hanging down, depending. --2 Delay, procrastination; न करु नितंबिनि गमनविलंबनं Gīt. 5; or तन्मुग्धे विफलं विलंबनमसौ रम्योऽ भिसारक्षणः ibid.
विलंबिका — Constipation.

(नी f.) 1 Hanging down, depending, pendent; नवांबुभिर्भूरिबिलंबिनो घनाः Ś. 5. 12. शिरीषम गंडविलंबि केशरं 6. 17; अलघुविलंबिपयोधरोपरुद्धाः Śi. 4. 29, 59; Ku. 1. 14; Ki. 5. 6; R. 16. 14, 18. 26; Mk. 5. 13. --2 Delaying, dilatory, being slow; भवति विलंबिनि विगलितलज्जा विलपति रोदिति वासकसज्जा Gīt. 6.

m: वि-√ लस् P. -लसति, to gleam, flash, glitter (only pr. p. -लसत्, q.v., and pf. -ललास, Bhaṭṭ.); to shine forth, appear, arise, become visible, Śiś.; to sound forth, echo (see वि-लसन्); to play, sport, dally, be amused or delighted, Kāv.; Kathās.; to vibrate, coruscate (see वि-लसत्) : Caus. -लासयति, to cause to dance, Vās.
a: विलस् — {c1c} P. 1 To shine, flash, glitter; वियति च विलिलास तद्वदिंदुर्विलसति चंद्रमसो न यद्वदन्यः Bk. 10. 68; Me. 47; R. 13. 76. --2 To appear, arise, become manifest; प्रेम विलसति महत्तदहो Śi. 15. 14; 9. 87. --3 To sport, amuse oneself, play, frolic about sportively; कापि चपला मधुरिपुणा विलसति युवतिरधिकगुणा Gīt. 7; or हरिरिह मुग्धवधूनिकरे विलासिनि विलसाति केलिपरे Gīt. 1; पर्यंके तया सह विललास H. 1. --4 To sound, echo, reverberate. --5 To act upon, work upon, show oneself; (खेदः) त्वयि विलसति तुल्यं वल्लभालोकनेन Māl. 3. 8. --6 To move about, dart, shoot up wards.

s: [t] tri, (vi + lasa + Satf .) vilAsayuktaH । yaTA, -- “vrajasuSruvo vilasatkalAH । aBavan priyA muravEriRaH ॥” iti CandomaYjarI ॥
m: वि-लसन् in comp. for वि-लसत्
वि-लसन n. gleaming, flashing (of lightning), Megh.
play, sport, ib.; Daś.
a: विलसनं — 1 Glittering, flashing, gleaming. --2 Sporting, dallying.

m: वि-लसन्—मरीचि mfn. having rays of light gleaming or playing, MW.
वि-लसन्—मेघ-शब्द m. the echoing sound of clouds (i.e. thunder), Kathās.
वि-लसत् mf(अन्ती)n. flashing, shining, glittering &c.
a: विलसत् — pres. a. (न्ती f.) 1 Glittering, shining, bright. --2 Flashing, darting. --3 Waving. --4 Sportive, playful; see विलस् above.

m: वि-लसत्—पताक mfn. having a gleaming or waving flag, MW.
वि-लसत्—सौदामिनी f. a flash of lightning, Bhartṛ.
वि-˚लसित mfn. gleaming, glittering, shining forth, appearing, BhP.
played, sported (n. also impers.), Kāv.; Kathās.
moving to and fro, BhP.
वि-˚लसित n. flashing, quivering (of lightning), Vikr.; Prab.
appearing, manifestation (विद्या, व्˚ manifestation of knowledge), Cat.
sport, play, pastime, dalliance, Kāv.; Kathās.
any action or gesture, Ragh.
a: विलसित — p. p. 1 Glittering, shining, gleaming. --2 Appeared, manifested. --3 Sportive, wanton. --तं 1 Glittering, gleaming. --2 A gleam, flash; रोधोभुवां मुहुग्मुत्र हिरण्मयीनां भासस्तडिद्विलसितानि विडंबयंति Ki. 5. 46. Me. 81, V. 4. --3 Appearance, manifestation; as in अज्ञानविलसितं &c. --4 Sport, play, dalliance, amorous or wanton gesture (fig. also); अतिपिशुनानि चैकांतनिष्टुरस्य दवैह कस्य विलसितानि K. --5 Action or gesture in general. --6 Effect, fruit, result; Māl. 2. 9.

m: वि-लय &c. See वि-√ ली, col. 3.

a: विलयः — 1 Dissolution, liquefaction. --2 Destruction, death, end; नयतु मामात्ममोंऽगेषु विलयमंबा U. 7. --3 Destruction or dissolution of the world; (विलयं गम् to be dissolved, to end, to be terminated, दिवसोऽ नुमित्रमगपद्विलयं Śi. 9. 17).

m: वि-˚लयन mfn. dissolving, liquefying, Suśr.
वि-˚लयन n. dissolution, liquefaction, ib.
melting (intrans.), Kaṇ.
a partic. product of milk, Gaut.; Gobh.
corroding, eating away, W.
removing, taking away, ib.
attenuating or an attenuant, escharotic (in medicine), ib.
a: विलयनं — 1 Dissolving, liquefying, dissolution. --2 Corroding. --3 Removing, taking away. --4 Attenuating. --5 An attenuant.

m: वि-लेखा f. a scratch, furrow, mark, MBh.; Suśr.
a written contract, Nār.
वि-लेख m. scratching, tearing up, wounding, Śiś.; KātyŚr., Sch.
वि-˚लेखन mfn. scratching, lacerating, Suśr.
वि-˚लेखन n. the act of making an incision or mark or furrow, Dhātup.
scratching, wounding, lacerating, Gaut.; MBh.
the course (of a river), Hariv.
dividing, splitting, W.
digging, delving, rooting up, ib.
a: विलेखनं — 1 Scratching, scraping, making a mark or furrow. --2 Digging. --3 Uprooting. --4 Dividing, splitting.

m: वि-˚लेखिन् mfn. scratching i.e. rubbing against, touching, reaching up to (ifc.), MBh.

m: वि-लेपी f. rice-gruel, Bhpr.; Car.

m: वि-लेप m. ointment, unguent (esp. the fragrant u˚ of sandal &c.), BhP.
anointing, plastering, W.
mortar, plaster, ib.

m: वि-˚लेपनी f. a woman scented with perfumes &c., L.
rice-gruel, L.
a: विलेपनी — 1 A woman scented with perfumes --2 A woman beautifully dressed or attired (सुवेशा). --3 Ricegruel.

m: वि-˚लेपन n. smearing, anointing (esp. with fragrant oils &c.), VarBṛS.; Kathās.; Suśr.
(ifc. f(आ). ), unguent, ointment, perfume for the person (as saffron, camphor &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a partic. mythical weapon, R.
a: विलेपनं — 1 Smearing, anointing. --2 An ointment, unguent, any cosmetic or perfume for the body (such as saffron, sandal &c); न स्नानं न विलेपनं न कुसुमं नालंकृता मूर्धजाः Bh. 2. 19; यान्येव सुरभिकुसुमधूपावलेपनादीनि K.

k.v: प्रतिबन्धः प्रविष्टम्भोऽवनायस्तु निपातनम्. उपलम्भस्त्वनुभवः समालम्भो विलेपनम्.।

वि-˚लेपिका f. a female anointer, L.
rice-gruel, L.
a: विलेपिका, विलेपी, विलेप्यः — Ricegruel.

viscous, sticky (in अ-विल्˚), Suśr.

m: वि-˚लेप्य mfn. to be (or being) spread over or plastered, made of mortar or clay, BhP.
वि-˚लेप्य mfn. rice-gruel, L.

m: वि-√ लिख् P. -लिखति (Ved. inf. -लिखस्; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 4, 13, Sch.), to scratch, scrape, tear up, lacerate, Lāṭy.; MBh. &c.; to rub against, reach to, touch, Hariv.; to wound (the heart) i.e. vex, offend, ŚBr.; to scratch in or on, make a furrow or mark, write, delineate, paint, Gol.; MBh. &c.; (in medicine) to tear up i.e. stir up (phlegm &c.), Car. : Caus. -लेखयति, or -लिखापयति, to cause to scratch or write, Kṛṣṇaj.
a: विलिख् — {c6c} P. 1 To write, inscribe. --2 To draw, paint, delineate, portray; विलिखति रहसि कुरंगमदेन भवंतमसमशरभूतं Gīt. 4. --3 To scratch, scrape, tear up; मंदं शब्दायमानो विलिखति शयनादुत्थितः क्ष्मां खुरण K. P. 10; व्यलिखच्चचुपुटेन पक्षती N. 2. 2; पादेन हैमं विलिलेख पीठं R. 6. 15; Ku. 2. 23. --4 To implant, infix; तावंतोपि विलिख्यंते हृदये शाकशकवः H. 4. 72 v. l.

m: वि-लिख See अ-विलिख.
वि-˚लिखन n. the act of scraping, scratching &c., Bālar.
a: विलिखनं — Scratching, scraping, writing.

वि—लिङ्ग n. absence of marks
वि—लिङ्ग mfn. of a different gender, Pat.
वि—लिङ्ग—स्थ mfn. not to be understood, MBh. ii, 845.
वि-√ लिश् Ā. -लिशते, to become out of joint, be disarranged or disordered, break off, become rent or torn, TS.; ŚBr.
विलिगी f. a kind of serpent, AV.
वि-√ लिह् P. Ā. -लेढि, -लीढे, to lick, lick up, lap, MBh.; BhP.; Suśr. : Intens. (only p. -लेलिहत् and ˚हान), to lick continually or repeatedly, MBh.
वि-लिम्पित mfn. (fr. Caus.) smeared, anointed, L.
विलि-नाथ m. (with कवि) N. of a poet (author of the drama Madana-mañjarī), Cat.

a: विलिप् — {c6c} P. 1 To smear, anoint. rub on; तथाहि नृत्याभिनयक्रियाच्युतं विलिप्यते मौलिभिरंबरौकसां Ku. 5. 79; Bk. 3. 20; 15. 6; Śi. 16. 62. --2 To pollute, defile, taint, contaminate.

m: 1. वि—लिप्ता or वि—लिप्˚तिका, f. a second (= 1/3600 of a degree), Gaṇit.
वि-लिप्ता f. See p. 952, col. 2
वि-लिप्ती f. a cow in a partic. period after calving, AV.
वि-लिप्त mf(आ)n. smeared over, anointed &c.
a: विलिप्त — p. p. 1 Anointed, besmeared, smeared over. --2 Polluted, stained, defiled.

m: विलिस्तेङ्गा f. N. of a Dānavī, Kāṭh.

वि-लिष्ट—भेषज n. a remedy for fractures or dislocation, AV.Paipp.

a: विल्ल — See बिल्ल.

puM, viloBanam । viSezaloBaH । vipUrvvakaluBaDAtorGaY pratyayena nizpannaH ॥

वि-लोभ &c. See वि-√ लुभ्, ib.
a: विलोभः — Attraction, seduction, allurement.

m: वि-˚लोभनीय mfn. enticing, alluring, Vās.; Kād.
वि-˚लोभन n. the act of leading astray, perplexing, beguiling, seduction, temptation, Ragh.; Kir.; Vās.
(in dram.) flattery, praise, commendation (e.g. Śak. i, 17-21, the stanzas containing the king's description of Śakuntalā's beauty), Bhar.; Daśar. &c.
a: विलोभनं — 1 Enticing, alluring. --2 An allurement, a temptation, seduction; प्रयुज्य सामाचरितं विलोभनं भयं विभेदाय धियः प्रदर्शितं Ki. 14. 7; R. 8. 60. --3 Praise, flattery.

m: वि-˚लोभित mfn. (fr. Caus.) allured, beguiled, deceived, flattered, praised, W.
वि-˚लोठिन् mfn. moving to and fro, dangling, Pracaṇḍ.
2. वि-लोच˚नाम्बु n. ‘eye-water’, tears, W.

of a mythical person, Kathās.
of an antelope, Hariv.

of Rudra and Fire (is identified with R˚), MW.
a kind of onion, L.

वि—लोक mfn. apart from the world, solitary, W.
